claims.text: Introduction/Context
Zotatifin is a clinical eIF4A inhibitor tested in 22Rv1 prostate cancer (PCa) cell xenografts in vivo.
After 6 h treatment, ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq) identified 554 downregulated transcripts (FDR<0.01, log2FC≤−0.3), and mass spectrometry (MS) found 339 downregulated proteins (p<0.05, log2FC≤−0.2).
Cross‐referencing with relaxed cutoffs (Ribo FDR<0.05 & log2FC<0; MS p<0.05 & log2FC<0) yielded 108 genes downregulated at both translational and protein levels.
Here, we prioritize among those common hits to highlight targets of particular relevance to prostate cancer.
Keywords
• zotatifin
• eIF4A
• translation initiation
• prostate cancer
• translatome
Candidate Genes
AR, CDK4, HIF1A, FOLH1
Pathway Enrichments
Across GSEA libraries, downregulated pathways dominate except in KEGG_2016.
